name: dev.shiranui-isuzu/unity-mcp
title: Unity MCP
description: Unity Editor automation for AI agents: scenes, prefabs, assets, shaders, Timeline, tests, builds.

environmentVariables.name: UNITY_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the Editor writes its descriptors. Set this only when the default location cannot be reached, such as from WSL.

environmentVariables.name: UNITY_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Replaces 127.0.0.1 in the descriptor endpoint, for reaching an Editor on the Windows host from WSL.
